title: Exact action danger window and full-lattice phase-mixing screen
analyticClaims: The scalar superlevel set for min(U,Vx)/(K+x) is an exact open interval below the maximum and empty at or above the maximum.
The full infinite zero-diffusion one-carrier chain has f_n(s)=sqrt(2) J_n'(2s), gradient moment 1+s^2, lifted action of order sigma^(4/3) log sigma, and frozen true-cubic coefficient 16/pi^2.
At fixed one-carrier geometry the benchmark lies in the action-poor safe branch of the inherited scalar ledger.
finiteDiagnostics: Producer and independent binary64 routes corroborate the Bessel identities, action scaling, and frozen cubic coefficient.
FFT phase splitting and a finite-chain Cayley splitting provide a convergence diagnostic for the dissipative chain.
The dissipative finite values do not prove a logarithmic asymptotic or a uniform continuum estimate.
claimBoundary: The analytic benchmark deletes the relative diagonal heat operator and therefore is not the dissipative triangular PDE. The finite dissipative points are diagnostics only. Nothing in this figure proves general three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity, a continuation criterion, or finite-time singularity.
